title: OSPD 2026 Geospatial Building Blocks Kernel
description: Kernel model that links process execution, provenance profile outputs, and process-type semantics.

functionalContract.principle: Conformance is defined by required behavior and evidence, not by one fixed input metadata schema.
requiredCapabilities: map the declared profile to the algorithm input contract
execute the declared process or return a structured validation failure
publish typed outputs with references to their source and execution evidence
minimumSemantics: input or output spatial, temporal, or coverage scope

algorithmContract.rule: Algorithm-specific fields remain inside the selected profile and must not become kernel-wide required metadata.

liabilityClaimsProfile.use: Attach liability, quality, provenance, and access evidence when supplied by the source or required by policy; do not require unrelated claim fields.

requires: valid liability-claims extension payload when liability evidence is present

rest.description: Plain HTTP/JSON access (job/result polling, register lookups) usable by any HTTP client regardless of API style.

ogcapi-processes.description: OGC API - Processes 1.0 execution model (/processes, /jobs/*) for synchronous or async job control.

ogcapi-records.description: OGC API - Records-like access for process-type register entries (/collections/process-types/items).

ogcapi-features.description: OGC API - Features Part 1 access for source feature collections and normalized query results.

esri-rest.description: ArcGIS MapServer/FeatureServer REST query adapter. This is not an OGC API binding; service version is deployment-dependent and responses are normalized to GeoJSON.

openapi.description: Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 document (/swagger.json) describing every REST/OGC API operation, enabling generated clients and orchestrators to bind to this kernel without hand-written integration.

openeo.description: ESA/openEO process-graph execution model (openEO API), enabling the same underlying workflow to be invoked as a batch job from any openEO back-end or client (e.g. openEO Platform, Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem).

bindingSelectionNotes: Each Building Block below declares which interface bindings it supports. A workflow should pick the binding that matches the data/service actually available for a given step (e.g. use openEO when the source is an openEO collection/back-end; use OGC API Features when an endpoint advertises the 1.0 conformance classes; use esri-rest for ArcGIS MapServer/FeatureServer query services; use OGC API Processes/Records for OGC execution/register access; fall back to plain REST + OpenAPI for generic HTTP integration) rather than assuming a single fixed interface end-to-end.

openeo.note: Exposed as an openEO-compatible process/batch job wrapping the same REANA/CWL execution behind /openeo/*.

buildingBlocks.title: OSPD Provenance Profile
buildingBlocks.notes: Consumed as job/result context over REST/OpenAPI; not natively an openEO concept, but process-type references inside it are cross-walked to openEO process ids via the process-type register mappings.

openeo.note: Process-type entries are cross-referenced to openEO process ids (e.g. atmospheric_correction) via closeMatch/exactMatch mappings in mappings/federation-mappings.json.

buildingBlocks.title: Geospatial Source Interoperability Adapter
buildingBlocks.normalization: GeoJSON to MGCP/NGIF with source interoperability context and conformance provenance

buildingBlocks.title: Sentinel-2 and DJI Imagery Harmonization
buildingBlocks.description: Two-workflow example for geometric correction, Sentinel-2 AI super-resolution, DJI area downsampling, masked histogram matching, and measurable photo-interpretation comparability.

sentinel2Reference.purpose: Produce the target grid, AI-enhanced reference image, and masked per-band histogram profile.

djiComparison.purpose: Orthorectify DJI observations, area-downsample to the reference grid, and match robust per-band distributions.

acceptance: registration RMSE below the configured threshold
configured histogram-distance and clipping thresholds pass

buildingBlocks.title: QGIS EDI Building Block Portfolio
buildingBlocks.description: Catalog of workspace-developed QGIS plugins and supporting geospatial services exposed through context-specific logical contracts.

contract.rule: Context-dependent metadata is retained inside a dynamically created contract and harmonized through kernel semantics and evidence rules.
